author: Afro-Latino Education & Arts Collective
title: Seeking Black Puerto Rican female illustrator for commission
content: Tag a Black Puerto Rican female illustrator. 🇵🇷🎨 PLEASE READ BEFORE SUBMITTING: As the Afro-Latino Education & Arts Collective, part of our mission is creating intentional opportunities for Black-identifying Latino artists and creatives. This particular commission is specifically seeking a Black-identifying Puerto Rican female illustrator. Puerto Rican heritage alone does not meet the criteria for this particular commission. Having African ancestry or Black relatives is also not the same as personally identifying as Black. We ask that applicants please respect the specificity of this opportunity so that space intentionally created for Black Puerto Rican female artists remains available to Black Puerto Rican female artists. Thank you for respecting the intention of the commission. Contact by tagging or DM.

author: Espoir School of Life
title: Hiring Storybook Illustrator (Paid Project)
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project) Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life. Espoir School of Life is a non-profit organization that provides free, inclusive, and liberating education alongside holistic community development programs for underprivileged children and their families in Siargao. The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives, community impacts, and grassroots projects to life through vibrant illustrations. ✨ How to Apply: If you want to help us bring these island narratives to life, please fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI Be ready to share your: • Contact Information • Portfolio Link • Expected Rate/Project Quotation We can’t wait to see your work! 🌴✨
